text: The Military Quarter (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating all the bosses in the Military Quarter of Naxxramas on 10-player mode.
The Mechanar is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the final boss of the Mechanar instance on normal or heroic difficulty.
The Magnificent Merleaux is a human located near the Violet Citadel in Dalaran. He can provide directions for various locations in the Dalaran. He also appears in the Violet Rise.

This is one of the Children's Week quests where you escort the Frenzyheart Wolvar orphan Kekek. Both of The Dragon Queen and The Mighty Hemet Nesingwary must be completed to progress to the next quest.
The Lurker Above is an achievement gained by fishing for in Serpentshrine Cavern.

This series of quests is restricted to mages, and is started at any mage trainer, and ends with receiving one of three wands. Many of the quests in this chain require travel in Dustwallow Marsh, and one requires venturing into Scarlet Monastery. Other than the limitations those elements require, all the quests in the chain can be undertaken at level 30.
The Might of Mograine is a passive buff rewarded from the quest The Light of Dawn (quest) and The Battle For The Ebon Hold. This buff works only during this quests.
The Middle Fragment of the World Pillar is a quest item of The Middle Fragment. It was originally locked away in The Stonefather's Safe and needs to be returned to Earthcaller Yevaa.

The Lone Hunter is a ghost wolf that still has Joseph Redpath's hunting blade embedded in its skull, which his daughter Pamela Redpath noted that he missed the blade. She asks players to get it back for her father.
The Limnologist is a fishing achievement. It is not part of the Accomplished Angler achievement. To complete it you have to successfully catch each of the 42 listed freshwater fish.
The Master's Flame is provided as an objective for The Lesson of the Burning Scroll.
__NOTOC__ The Manipulator is a human associated with the Twilight's Hammer clan. He tries to stop you from using the Eye of Twilight.
The Long Riders is a player vs. player achievement earned for escorting a mine cart from its spawn point to a depot and capturing it, without losing control of the cart in Silvershard Mines.
The Metal Brew is looted from A Keg of Metal Brew, found at at the Shrine of Fellowship in northwestern Jade Forest. Sam the Wise will tap the keg after he is defeated in combat.
The Mind-Killer is an achievement that is awarded for defeating Sha of Fear in the Terrace of Endless Spring raid instance without any raid members being feared by Dread Spray or Breath of Fear.

The Longest Day is a pet battles achievement awarded for completing 41 pet battle daily quests within one daily quest reset period. Players only need to complete either the Alliance or the Horde Azeroth daily quests, not both, to satisfy the "Azeroth Dailys - A/H" criterion.
The Maze of Mad Emperor Ku was one of the pandaren legends told by Lorewalker Shuchun to Ziya and Druz.
The Might of Virtue is a level 75 Retribution paladin talent.
the Manslayer is a title awarded upon completing the Garrison achievement Nemesis: Manslayer. The title appears after your character's name: : the Manslayer>
The Manastorm Decision appears in Hall of the Guardian during Finding Ebonchill.

The Mad Merchant is a gnome vendor who occasionally appears in the Wonderworks in Dalaran over the Broken Isles that sells several unique items for extremely high amounts of gold. He is on a random spawn timer, but will spawn region-wide for an hour at a time.

The Mantle of Command is sold by Arcanomancer Vridiel in Dalaran for and has a chance to drop from Agronox in the Cathedral of Eternal Night, General Xakal in the Arcway, and Brother Badatin on the Broken Shore.
There are two quests that share this name: * The Mind of the Enemy (paladin) * The Mind of the Enemy (priest)
Both The Lost Advisor and An Ancient Recipe are available at the beginning.
The Lion of Azeroth is a carrier located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in .
The Lil' Necromancer is earned for beating 12 of the trainers listed with a team composed only by undead pets.
The Many-Faced Devourer is an ur'zul located in the Scavenger's Boneyard in the Antoran Wastes. It is summoned with the Bone Effigy created with the Call of the Devourer.
The Loan Shark is a submarine located at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
the Lightbringer is a title rewarded for obtaining Paragon of Argus. The title will show after the character's name, in the following format: :, the Lightbringer

The Maw Must Feed is a blood death knight artifact trait gained from Maw of the Damned. This is a hidden trait that does not appear in either your spellbook or the artifact traits pane. The effect triggers when killing a non-elite humanoid or demon, stacks up to 10%, and lasts 30 seconds.
The MOTHERLODE!! is a dungeon achievement earned for defeating Mogul Razdunk in The MOTHERLODE!!.

The Maiden's Virtue was a ship docked in Bridgeport in Tiragarde Sound, Kul Tiras. It was a smuggler ship run by Captain Keelson and her crew. During the quest Stow and Go, the player gets to follow how The Maiden's Virtue is lured in by sirens, and unfortunately crash into the rocky shores of the Wailing Tideway.
The Matron Shaazula is a Zandalari troll located in Nazmir. She is a bad parent.
The McWeaksauce Classic was only available during testing for Naxxramas.
__NOTOC__ The Mechagonian Threat is a quest achievement earned for completing the Mechagon storyline.
The Master of Lies is the climax of the Revendreth storyline.
The Master of Revendreth is a quest achievement earned by completing a series of Revendreth storylines.
The Master is a stone plaque found in Pridefall Hamlet in Revendreth.
The Magister is a Maw caster hovering above Gorgoa near the Crucible of the Damned in the Maw.
The Maker's Lift Controller is the controller for the Maker's Rise in the Halls of Origination.
The Malice of Maldraxxus is a book located in Darkwall Tower in Revendreth.
The Mass of Souls is a shade located at various locations in the Maw during a Tormentors of Torghast event.
The Meaning of Wrath breadcrumbs players back to Korthia, ending the sixth chapter of nine in the Chains of Domination campaign. The seventh chapter begins at :Renown 52 with A Cry From the Heart.

The Many Trials of Zo'Sorg is a player vs. player achievement that isn't available to players. Trials of Zo'Sorg would presumably have been a type of World PvP quest or event, but they weren't implemented.
The Lupine Prime's Might drops from Vexis in the Great Veldt in Zereth Mortis.

The Lunker Below is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by using fishing to lure the Lurking Lunker living in the lava out, then engage and defeat the Primal Council in the Vault of the Incarnates on Normal difficulty or higher.
The Lord of the Wings can be found in the Life-Binder Conservatory while on Library of Alexstrasza.

The Long Knives takes place halfway through the Heritage of Draenor questline. The quest giver and quest text changes depending on which clan the player picked in the preceding quest, The Blessing of the Clan.

.]] The Mighty Kodo Pack is a bundle of a kodo mount with a matching pet for the normal mount price of $25 from the Battle.net Shop or the In-Game Store. The bundle became available on 14 July 2023 with no indication it'll be removed.
The Living Drill is a Sniffenseek dig adventure started with Myrrit in Loamm in Zaralek Cavern.

"The New Horde" is a section of the History of Warcraft, Chapter IV. It is set after Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal and recounts the events of the novel Lord of the Clans. Found at: * Tower of Northwatch Hold in Southern Barrens. * The Royal Library of Stormwind Keep in Stormwind, next to the right column just as you enter the library) * Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows - building with the trainers Timeline: * ← Previous book: Lethargy of the Orcs * → Next book: War of the Spider
This quest starts the alliance version of the series of quests.
This quest unites the Horde and Alliance versions of the quest chains.
The Ongar is a rare mob ooze found at Bloodvenom Falls in Felwood.
This quest is part of the Green Scepter Shard fork of The Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj

In The Pariah's Instructions, the Centaur Pariah asks you to enter Maraudon and defeat the Nameless Prophet and the five first centaur Khans, in order to complete the Amulet of Union. The Centaur Pariah hopes to use this amulet to unite the centaur tribes.
This is part of the main Blasted Lands quest chain, although it takes place in Azshara.
__NOTOC__ The Night Blade is an epic dagger with a critical strike proc.
The Natural Ward is an epic ring that grants a stamina bonus as well as a significant amount of nature resistance.
__NOTOC__ The Night Watchman is an leather helm. Equipping it grants an increase to stealth detection.
The Not-So-Friendly Skies... is a once-daily collection quest, available starting at reputation with Netherwing after completing Your Friend On The Inside.
After receiving an Overseer's Badge for advancing to reputation with Netherwing, Varkule directs players to the mines with this quest.
The Pack Mistress sends the players into Lower Blackrock Spire to find and defeat Halycon, the den mistress of the worgs.
In which you venture into the dangerous areas of Gnomeregan to help find a cure for the leper gnomes.

The Newest Member of the Family is an Alliance only quest in which the player must rush a sprite darter egg to the Hinterlands, where a dwarf lives who can help look after it. This is part of the Freedom for All Creatures quest chain, which will eventually award the player with a baby sprite dragon pet, very cute and highly desired. The chain starts with Freedom for All Creatures in Feralas.

This quest concludes the Draconic For Dummies: Volume II portion of the Blue Scepter Shard fork of The Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. Both the Narain's Scrying Goggles and the 500 Pound Chicken forks must also be complete before Narain Soothfancy will offer the conclusion of the Blue Shard fork, The Good News and The Bad News.
This quest is part of the Green Scepter Shard fork of The Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.
This quest is part of the introduction to The Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.
The Obliterator Greaves drop from Zuramat the Obliterator in the Violet Hold on heroic mode.
The Oblivion is a Forsaken battleship, and part of the Windrunner Fleet, located off the Derelict Strand in the Howling Fjord. It is currently under attack from North Fleet Marines.
The Oracles is an achievement gained by getting with the Oracles in Sholazar Basin.

The Northrend Gourmet is a series of Cooking achievements which asks the player to cook up Wrath of the Lich King-cooking recipes. Due to the slow accumulation of Epicurean's Award, which is used to buy several of the recipes, completing these achievements will take some time.
The Nexus is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the listed bosses of the Nexus.
the Noble is a title awarded when a player completes the Noblegarden achievement Noble Gardener. The title appears after your character's name: : the Noble
The Oculus is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the listed bosses in The Oculus.
The Party's Over was a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Prince Taldaram in Ahn'kahet on Heroic difficulty with less than 5 people.

Hemet Nesingwary was well known for his expedition camp in Stranglethorn Vale. With the opening of the Dark Portal and Outland, Hemet Nesingwary left his son in charge of the safari there, and established a new camp in eastern Nagrand. They may have some problems with their aircraft, and with injuries to the hunters, but they are still carrying on with their hunting. As with the Stranglethorn safari, completing the final quest gains you a significant reward. Classes that used ranged weapons have their choice of a gun, throwing axe, or a wand. Classes that don't use ranged items (Paladin, Druid, Shaman) will be even more interested as they are offered a rare item for their ranged-equivalent s
The North Wind is an air revenant that can be summoned within the Temple of Life in Storm Peaks.

The Outland Gourmet is a cooking achievement for cooking all of the Outland cooking recipes. It is one of the required achievements for the title, from completing the meta-achievement Hail to the Chef.
This achievement requires you to fish from any school of fish. The name of this achievement is a reference to Ernest Hemingway's novella The Old Man and the Sea.

The Orb Whisperer (25 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the Blood Council without anyone in the raid taking more than 25,000 spell damage in a single hit on 25-player mode.
The Only Escape is a tier 11 raid achievement. Completing this achievement is a criterion for the meta achievement .
The Molten Front Offensive is a quest achievement earned for unlocking the quests on the attack of Molten Front. Requirement for the meta-achievement Veteran of the Molten Front.
This short quest chain introduces you to the Fire Lasher referred to in the achievement The Molten Front Offensive, and opens up another daily quest in the Molten Front.
*The Path of the Conqueror (Neutral) **The Path of the Conqueror (Friendly) ***The Path of the Conqueror (Honored) ****The Path of the Conqueror (Revered)
Taylor fought against the hozen like a wild beast. He is a great credit to your people! But in the end, he was overcome.

This article is a copy of "The Murlocs," an official article by Blizzard Entertainment. It presented a variety of information about murlocs. The original article, formerly located at [http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/misc/murloclore/murlocs.html], did not survive the overhaul of the World of Warcraft Official Website.

The Mogu and the Trogg is a book found at several locations, including the northeast corner of the lower level of the Scrollkeeper's Sanctum, Temple of the Jade Serpent, Jade Forest, and at the feet of in the Seat of Knowledge, above the entrance to Mogu'shan Palace in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. It contains the origin story of the grummles and a parable that is somewhat based on their role in the overthrow of the mogu.

The Nature of Peace is a readable scroll that hangs in Master Windfur's house in Dawn's Blossom in the Jade Forest, on the ground floor near the center of The Scrollkeeper's Sanctum in the Temple of the Jade Serpent, on the second floor of Apothecary Cheng's house in Binan Village, and inside the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
The Monkey King is a hozen who was a companion of Shaohao, the last emperor of Pandaria.

The Mogu Below-gu is a quest achievement earned for summoning and defeating three named mogu, whose gravestones can be found on the surface of the Court of Bones. See their respective articles for more information. This achievement is not required for the meta-achievement, Stormbreaker, but its followup, These Mogu Have Gotta Go-gu, is.

The Pandaren Gourmet is one of the Cooking-achievements added in Mists of Pandaria. It requires the player to cook up 15 of the recipes added in the same expansion. Completing the achievement requires learning all types of Pandaren cooking, including the six Ways (Grill, Wok, Pot, Steamer, Oven, and Brew).

The Obvious Solution is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for eliminating the remaining Sha imprisoned in the Sealed Chambers and then defeat the Sha of Violence in Shado-Pan Monastery on Heroic difficulty.
The Night Haunter is a dire orc located at Zorammarsh in Tanaan Jungle. Can be summoned when you get 10 stacks of Marked by the Night Haunter.
There are 2 quests that share this name: * The Nexus Vault (mage) * The Nexus Vault (priest)
The Mysteries of the Wild Gods was available during the development stages of World of Warcraft: Legion. However, it was removed prior to release.
The Overseer is an inquisitor appearing in front of the Tomb of Sargeras during The Battle for Broken Shore (quest). He is summoned by . He later reappeared on Niskara.

__NOTOC__ The Nameless King is a rare mob vrykul located in the Field of Fallen Kings in Stormheim. He is actually the vrykul king, Torvald the Defiant. Upon interacting with the Offering Shrine, his corpse arises to challenge you. Torvald's spirit then arises from his body upon defeat.
The Nightfallen is an achievement rewarded for earning exalted reputation with The Nightfallen faction in the Broken Isles.
The Original is about collecting a full set of Season 1 armor (including bracer, belt and boots) for one class.
The Nighthold Guild Run is an achievement that is awarded for defeating all bosses in the Nighthold on Normal difficulty or higher while in a guild group.

The Mute is an undead being that can be encountered as a boss in the single-player experience in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone. As her name indicates, she is unable to speak as her mouth appears to be stitched shut.
__NOTOC__ The Nodding Tiger is an elite tiger in the Scrollkeeper's Sanctum of the Temple of the Jade Serpent. It is a creature from pandaren literature brought to life by Haunting Sha.
The Next 70 Levels is an add-on pack to the highly popular game Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness. It is the first "The Next x Levels" add-on; it was followed by The Next 350 Levels.
The Next 350 Levels is an add-on pack to the highly popular game Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness. It is the second "The Next x Levels" add-on, released after The Next 70 Levels.
The Mists of Sheilun is a Mistweaver monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Extended Healing, Infusion of Life, Light on Your Feet, and Way of the Misteaver traits.
The Origins of the Mogu is a tome located in the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
The Nest Egg is a ghost submarine belonging to pirates who tore themselves apart over stolen goods.

The Most Horrific Vision of Stormwind is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing all objectives in the Horrific Vision of Stormwind in a single visit and with all 5 Faceless Masks active.

The Most Horrific Vision of Orgrimmar is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing all objectives in the Horrific Vision of Orgrimmar in a single visit and with all 5 Faceless Masks active.
The Path to Ascension is a quest achievement earned by completing the primary Bastion storyline.
The Path Towards Ascension 1 is an expansion feature achievement earned by defeating a boss in the Path of Ascension.
The Path Towards Ascension 3 is an expansion feature achievement earned by defeating three boss in the Path of Ascension.
The Path Towards Ascension 5 is an expansion feature achievement earned by defeating five boss in the Path of Ascension.
The Path Towards Ascension 7 is an expansion feature achievement earned by defeating seven boss in the Path of Ascension.
The Path Towards Ascension 12 is an expansion feature achievement earned by defeating 12 bosses in the Path of Ascension.
The Path Towards Ascension 16 is an expansion feature achievement earned by defeating 16 bosses in the Path of Ascension.
The Path Towards Ascension 20 is an expansion feature achievement earned by defeating 20 bosses in the Path of Ascension.
The Path Towards Ascension 24 is an expansion feature achievement earned by defeating 24 bosses in the Path of Ascension.
The Path Towards Ascension 39 is an expansion feature achievement earned by defeating 39 bosses in the Path of Ascension.
The Necrotic Wake is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Nalthor the Rimebinder in the Necrotic Wake.

The Necronom-i-nom is located in a bookshelf on the top floor of the Sepulcher of Knowledge's main tower in Maldraxxus. The interior of the tower—and by extension this toy—can only be accessed after opening the door into the structure during Slaylines. __NOTOC__
The Naga, the Queen, & the Clamshell is a tome located in Sagehold in Stormsong Valley.
The Paragons is a scroll found in the Vestibule of Eternity in Bastion.
The Party Herald is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing the Ember Court achievements listed below.

The Nathrezim concludes the sixth chapter of the Chains of Domination campaign, "The Unseen Guests", though there is a breadcrumb back to Korthia next. Venthyr Covenant players have some covenant-specific follow-ups, starting with Medallion of Wrath (quest). The seventh chapter of nine starts at :Renown 52 with A Cry From the Heart.

The New Path concludes the penultimate chapter of the Chains of Domination campaign, "A New Path". A breadcrumb back to Korthia is next, then the final chapter will begin at :Renown 58 with Doorway in the Dark.
The Nine is a boss encounter located in the Sanctum of Domination. It is a council-style fight primarily against the three surviving members of Sylvanas Windrunner's Val'kyr.
The Pantheon's Bounty is a chest located in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
The Party Herald's Party Hat is sold by Temel in Sinfall for .
The Nokhud Offensive is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Balakar Khan in the Nokhud Offensive.
The Nokhud Threat concludes the "Maruukai" chapter of the Ohn'ahran Plains storyline.
The Ohn'ahran Trail is an exploration achievement earned by defending Clan Aylaag between all three of their camp locations.

The Ol Raszle Daszle is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Raszageth the Storm-Eater after successfully gathering two Concentrated Storm Essences and defeating the Concentrated Storm in Vault of the Incarnates on Normal difficulty or higher.
The Obsidian Bloodline is a reputation achievement earned by reaching the maximum friendship with Sabellian at the Obsidian Throne.
The Nokhud Offensive: The Final Ancestor concludes the optional "Elder Nazuun" storyline in Teerakai.
The Nokhud Offensive: The Wind Belongs to the Sky is an optional dungeon quest offered after completion of Renewal of Vows at the end of the Ohn'ahran Plains storyline.
The Nokhud Offensive: Founders Keepers concludes the optional "The Eternal Kurgans" storyline in Teerakai.
The Never-Final Countdown concludes the "Time Management" chapter of the Thaldraszus storyline. The final chapter of the campaign begins with Tumbling Through Time.

The Path of Ishtaar Drawing is provided by Jhara at Pinewood Post in the Ohn'ahran Plains while solving A Proper Burial during Secrets of Azeroth. Additional pages are added as Aged Markers are visited, along with the final stop, the Large Unmarked Stone Cairn.
__NOTOC__ The Rake is a rare mob lion found in Mulgore, east of Thunder Bluff in the Golden Plains. He is on a one hour spawn timer.

The Postmaster is a cloth set collectors can assemble within Stratholme. It is one of very few gear collections within World of Warcraft of which all parts drop from a single source. The Postmaster is also one of a select few cloth sets which offers extra armor as a set bonus.
The Prophecy of Mosh'aru is the 2nd quest in the Screecher Spirits quest chain.

The Prophecy of C'Thun written by the Qiraji Prophet Skeram. The player of World of Warcraft is introduced to this prophecy by after completing The Calling. The Prophet Skeram is an important religious leader in Ahn'Qiraj, and author of The Prophecy of C'Thun. He is the first boss found in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj and must be defeated for access to the rest of the zone.

An occasional term used to describe the overwhelming Alliance advantage of numbers over Horde on the vast majority of WoW servers, which frequently surpasses 2:1. Many causes have been theorised for this problem, from the logically plausible (players feel more comfortable playing human-like characters), to the unfathomably silly (the Alliance has usable chairs). Whatever the cause, this Ratio frequently causes an effect in PvP known as "The Zerg", in which Alliance forces gather into a numerically superior mob and overwhelm the defenses of a single site. However, in the battlegrounds it has the opposite effect such that wait queues for Alliance are so long that it is much harder for regular
The Ravenian is an elite wight mini-boss found in Scholomance.
The Postmaster's Band is a Level 45 quality Cloth Headband that belongs to The Postmaster set. It improves Intellect, Stamina and Haste.
The Postmaster's Trousers is a pair of Level 45 quality Cloth Pants that belong to The Postmaster set. They improve Intellect, Stamina and Haste.
The Postmaster's Treads is a Level 45 quality Ring that belongs to The Postmaster set. It improves Intellect, Stamina and Haste.
The Postmaster's Treads is a pair of Level 45 quality Cloth Boots that belong to The Postmaster set. They improve Intellect, Stamina and Haste.
The Postmaster's Tunic is a Level 45 quality Cloth Tunic that belongs to The Postmaster set. It improves Intellect, Stamina and Haste.
This is the second part of the tasks to specialize in Goblin Engineering.
__NOTOC__ The Plague Bearer is an epic tanking shield with frost resistance bonus.
__NOTOC__ The Purifier is a gun with a bonus to critical strike rating. It is acquired via Argent Dawn quests turn-ins.
The Rescue is a Horde quest in Hillsbrad Foothills that involves finding and rescuing two orc hostages from the Syndicate in Durnholde Keep.

The Forsaken forces in Brill, a Forsaken town in Tirisfal Glades, have learned of a Scarlet Crusade messenger who carries important information that may be of value to the Forsaken and their efforts to lessen the Scarlet Crusade threat. You are to kill the messenger and acquire that information.
The Relic's Emanation is a daily quest available after you complete An Apexis Relic.
In The Prophecy of Velen, the character meets the commander of the Alliance naval force, lands on the south coast of Azuremyst Isle, and uncovers goblin treachery...

The Prophecy of Akida is a quest chain that starts in Azure Watch, in Azuremyst Isle. This quest chain is a prerequisite for the various quests at Stillpine Hold. This series of quests is widely regarded as some of the most fun quests in the game. The object of the series is twofold - to learn the furbolg language, and to fulfill portions of the Prophecy of Akida.
The Respect of Another is about a boy and a girl and a gigantic wasp.
The Relics of Terokk is provided for Terokk's Legacy (BC Classic).
The People's Militia is a quest chain which may be a prerequisite for the Defias Brotherhood quest chain.
This quest is one of two required for Alliance version of the Rotten Hallow achievement.
The Prisoners is the tenth mission of the Alliance campaign in Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness.

The Purple Princess is a zeppelin, with a goblin crew and troll guards, which runs between Brill in Tirisfal Glades and Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale. In World of Warcraft: Battle for Azeroth the zeppelin was replaced by mage portals, as the crew went on strike after not being paid for the last eleven years.
The Plaguebringer's Girdle is a quest reward from The Plaguebringer's Request.
The Razing of Tyr's Hand is the ninth mission of the Horde campaign in Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness.
The Refiner's Fire is part of the Sons of Hodir quest chain.

The RP-GG (abbreviation of Rocket-Propelled Goblin Grenade) is an item unique to the Wintergrasp PvP Combat Zone. Friendly workshops will spawn a row of interactable rockets that, when clicked on by a player, will place a stack of five of these items in their inventory. The item's intention is to give a player on foot a weapon to deal with the various vehicles piloted by other players during rounds of combat. It is named after the Russian grenade/rocket launcher series RPG - Ruchnoy Protivotankoviy Granatomyot (the most known model is RPG-7).

]] The Queen's Reprisal is a battleship serving in the Forsaken navy. Originally a part of the Windrunner Fleet involved in the War against the Lich King, the Queen's Reprisal has recently taken part in the Burning Legion's third invasion where it helped fight the demons, along with the rest of the Horde's forces. The ship is named for Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, Banshee Queen of the Forsaken.
The Plague Quarter (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating all the bosses in the Plague Quarter of Naxxramas on 10-player mode.
The Pearl of the Depths is a giant pearl sitting on a stone table in the Dragonblight.
The Perfect Storm is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning the Eye of the Storm with a score of 1500 to 0.

The Prophecy is the opening cinematic of Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos. It was originally created as the first trailer for the game. The cinematic was remade as a cinematic trailer for Warcraft III: Reforged.
The Plagueworks (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the bosses of The Plagueworks in Icecrown Citadel on 10-player mode.
The Pie Chairs can be found around Bountiful Tables outside all major cities and most minor towns throughout Azeroth and Outland.
The Pilgrim is a title reward given by Pilgrim. The title appears after your character's name: : the Pilgrim
the Patient is a title awarded when you complete Looking For Many by repeatedly running dungeons using the Dungeon Finder. The title appears after your character's name: : the Patient

The Rawrcast Show is a weekly World of Warcraft podcast produced by Haf (Rusty) and Stompalina (Denise). Together they cover game-related topics, news, opinions, and reviews. They also occasionally welcome guests who help to shape our in-game adventures, and our out-of-game community of players. The Prince and the Prophet is an interlude in the Scourge of Lordaeron campaign.

The Prodigal Leader is Arthas Menethil set in the past. The players will be thrown into a "vision" and see what Arthas saw. The vision will end if the player leaves the First Legion Forward Camp in Icecrown.
The Pewter Pounder is provided as an objective for the following quests: *Decisions, Decisions *Here... You Do It
The Refleshifier is provided for Refleshification, taken from Weapons Cabinet that belongs to Horzak Zignibble.
The Quick and the Dead is a guild perk that gives guild members faster movement speed as a ghost and increases the starting health when resurrected, except in Battlegrounds or Arenas.

The Pipe is an area of Kezan. It is a pipe with a road going through it that connects the westernmost part of Bilgewater Port with Drudgetown. The Pipe contains an opening that looks into a massive foundry-styled industrial facility manned by forest trolls.
The Rattle of Bones are provided for The Rattle of Bones (quest) to be delivered to Feralas Sentinel and Freewind Brave.

__NOTOC__ The Ray-Getz-Kalaba Monstrosity is a flesh beast located in the Sludge Fields of Hillsbrad Foothills. According to Master Apothecary Lydon, it was "pieced together out of three farmers". Lydon wants it and Warden Stillwater's other monstrosities dealt with before the final confrontation with Stillwater.
The Pen is Mightier is a guild achievement for creating 2,500 glyphs.
The Purifier's Prayer Book is retrieved from the corpse of Delgren the Purifier. Sentinel Onaeya wishes to return it to the Argent Dawn embassy in Darnassus.

A Machinima by Rothicol. The Peak of Serenity - Begin Your Training is the first of a long line of -specific quests that take place at the Peak of Serenity, a monastery that serves as a training ground and refuge for the monk class. This initial quest is intended to familiarize the player with the use of the Zen Pilgrimage skill, which allows the monk to quickly transport him or herself to the Peak of Serenity for easy access to class trainers and future class quests. This quest and the skill required to complete it are automatically added to the player's quest log and spell book at level 20.

The Pit is an area in northern Gorgrond, to the west of Blackrock Foundry. Iron Horde operations are carried out in the area, including weapon construction, troop training and laborers mining the surrounding area. Rare diamonds can be unearthed here. Alliance and Horde forces attempt to disrupt work during the daily quest Assault on the Pit and Missive: Assault on the Pit.

__NOTOC__ The Scepter of the Shifting Sands is an item created from an extremely long quest chain. The beginning of this quest chain began in Cenarion Hold. This scepter was required to ring The Scarab Gong that opened the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj, thus allowing the entire server access to both the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj and the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj. Though it was still possible to acquire the scepter after the opening of the gates, it could not be used to ring the gong.

__NOTOC__ The Scarlet Key is the master key to the most heavily-guarded areas claimed by the Scarlet Crusade - the Armory and Cathedral wings of the Scarlet Monastery. The key was also once used to open the Scarlet Bastion in Western Stratholme; this requirement was removed during patch 3.2.0.
The Savior of Kalimdor is the followup to C'Thun's Legacy, as a reward for killing C'Thun and looting the Eye of C'Thun.

The Restrained Essence of Sapphiron is a trinket that is designed for a caster class such as mages or warlocks. Some would argue that this item is optimal for a dual use class such as a shadowpriest, but such debates are always contentious. Realistically all caster classes can benefit from this item.
The Rockpounder is a two-handed mace which increases the users chance to get a critical strike.

The Scarlet Crusade is the single biggest threat to the Forsaken. Even though the Forsaken is free of the Lich King's control and fights against the Scourge (the enemy of the Scarlet Crusade as well), the Scarlet Crusade has sworn to eliminate all undead from Azeroth. This quest is the first that pits you against Scarlet Crusade forces.
This is the final quest in a chain beginning after you complete To Kill With Purpose (Classic), Un-Life's Little Annoyances, and The Ranger Lord's Behest.
